state.objective: Determine which of 104 held legacy accounts can be resolved using only five client files now available, and which must remain provisional.
available_files: Current MASTER ASSET: 1,342 asset rows through 2026 with asset name, value, depreciation rate/life, purchase date, period, asset GL, debit/credit depreciation GL, department, depreciation method, asset type and status.
Older asset list: asset classes and indicative depreciation lives.
December 2025 balance sheet by HO and 13 units.
September 2026 sales summary by division with quantity, gross sales, discount, returns, net sales and average-cost COGS.
missing_files: Transaction-level general ledger and opening-item detail.
Owner/principal funding agreements and repayment terms.
Inventory write-off/disposal documents and movement ledger.
Cheque/giro lifecycle register and bank statements.

observed_evidence.replacement_oe: All 36 Reserve Replacement OE balance-sheet detail lines are zero in the December 2025 report, and all 36 corresponding Replacement OE expense lines are zero in the 2025/2024 P&L. The current asset register nevertheless contains underlying OE items such as racks, hangers, mannequins, tables, boxes, sensors and shopping baskets with asset value and site-specific asset accounts.
observed_evidence.principal: Principal balances are material. The balance sheet contains 14 site-named Principal accounts, PJP current Principal, and long-term Principal. Reports show balances but no counterparty agreements or repayment substance.
observed_evidence.hgb: HGB/land-right cost, accumulated amortization and land-right expense lines shown are zero. The older asset-class list includes Hak Pengelolaan Tanah with a 3-year life, but no legal right contract is available.
observed_evidence.rent: Land rent expense is zero, but store/warehouse rent and staff-house/mess rent have activity in the 2025/2024 P&L. Contracts are unavailable.
observed_evidence.preopening: Pre-opening cost and accumulated amortization have non-zero balances; pre-opening amortization expense is zero in the 2025/2024 P&L. No cost detail or opening-date schedule is available.
observed_evidence.cip: Current asset register has 668 rows classified Contract in Progress across HO and units. Balance sheet CIP is non-zero. Project status and placed-in-service documents are unavailable.
observed_evidence.disposed_inventory: Disposed Inventory has a non-zero balance. Movement/write-off documents are unavailable.
observed_evidence.inventory_damage: Inventory Damage Expense is zero in the 2025/2024 P&L.
observed_evidence.purchase_discount: Purchase Discount has activity in both comparative years. Inventory posting policy and transaction detail are unavailable.
observed_evidence.mixed_other: Mixed Other Income/Expense has activity and changes sign across the comparative data; transaction detail is unavailable.
observed_evidence.current_tax: Current Tax Income/Expense PPh 25 is zero, while PPh 25 payable/prepaid-related lines exist elsewhere. Tax returns and reconciliation are unavailable.
observed_evidence.sales: Sales file demonstrates that division, discount, return, net sales and COGS analysis exists outside the GL account code.

state.control_rule: Zero balance supports retirement only when historical activity, open items and posting-rule references have also been checked. Where those are unavailable, the decision may be approved for future posting design while legacy migration remains provisional.

files_sufficient_all.instructions: Are the five files sufficient to finalize all 104 hold accounts?

criteria.no: They provide strong structural evidence but lack transaction, contract, tax and reconciliation evidence for all groups.
criteria.yes: They are sufficient for every classification and migration decision.

replacement_future_design.instructions: Are the files sufficient to remove the 72 item-specific Replacement OE accounts from the future posting COA?

criteria.yes: The register holds item/site identity and both report families show zero; use governed OE/asset and expense accounts instead.
criteria.no: Keep all 72 item-specific accounts for future posting.

replacement_migration_close.instructions: Are the files alone sufficient to certify that all 72 legacy Replacement OE accounts have no open migration items?

criteria.provisional: No; future design can remove them, but confirm opening balances, historical activity and posting-rule references before final deactivation.
criteria.yes: The two summary reports alone certify every migration item.

principal_resolution.instructions: Can the Principal accounts be finalized from the reports alone?

criteria.no: Keep provisional until counterparty, agreement, maturity, repayment and owner-equity substance are documented.
criteria.liability: Classify all as one payable immediately.

principal_site_dimension.instructions: Regardless of liability-versus-equity classification, should 14 site names remain separate natural accounts?

criteria.no: Units are sites of one entity; use a single proper nature account plus site/document analysis where needed.
criteria.yes: Retain one Principal GL per unit.

hgb_resolution.instructions: Can the zero HGB lines be fully retired from these files alone?

criteria.provisional: Future posting may avoid unused item-specific lines, but legal right and opening/activity checks are still required before migration closure.
criteria.yes: Zero summary values prove no right exists.
criteria.keep: Keep all lines permanently without contract review.

rent_resolution.instructions: How should active store/warehouse and mess rent accounts be treated with no contracts?

criteria.retain_pending: Retain appropriate rent expense/prepaid capability and defer lease/HGB classification until contracts are reviewed.
criteria.merge_all: Merge immediately into one general OPEX account.

preopening_resolution.instructions: Can non-zero pre-opening balances be finalized from these files?

criteria.no: Require cost composition, opening dates, policy and roll-forward before expense/reclass/retirement.

cip_resolution.instructions: What do the register and non-zero balance establish for CIP?

criteria.retain_one: A governed CIP account/subledger is required now; consolidate site-specific identity into project/site dimensions, but reconcile projects before capitalization.
criteria.keep_site_accounts: One CIP natural account per unit is required.

disposed_resolution.instructions: Can non-zero Disposed Inventory be finalized without movement/write-off evidence?

criteria.no: Require quantity/value movements, approvals, proceeds and reconciliation.

damage_zero.instructions: Can zero Inventory Damage Expense be removed from future posting design?

criteria.map: Yes as an item-specific legacy name; future damage/loss events map to the governed inventory-loss account and reason codes, while migration deactivation still checks references.
criteria.keep: Keep a separate permanent damage account.

purchase_discount_resolution.instructions: Can active Purchase Discount be finalized from summary reports alone?

criteria.no: Require purchasing/inventory posting policy and transactions to decide inventory cost, AP settlement or separate presentation.

mixed_other_resolution.instructions: What can be concluded about mixed Other Income/Expense from comparative activity?

criteria.split_required: The future design must prohibit a mixed-sign account and split transactions by nature; actual migration mapping needs transaction detail.
criteria.net: Net the existing balance without analysis.

tax_resolution.instructions: Can zero Current Tax PPh 25 expense be finalized without returns/reconciliation?

criteria.provisional: Remove the ambiguous legacy label from future posting and use governed tax accounts, but verify old balances/mappings against tax returns before closure.
criteria.yes: Zero P&L proves no tax exposure.
criteria.keep: Keep the ambiguous mixed tax account permanently.

sales_dimensions.instructions: Does the sales summary support keeping division and product mix outside natural accounts?

criteria.yes: Division, discounts, returns and COGS analysis are already source/subledger attributes and reports; retain only appropriate natural account distinctions.
criteria.no: Create separate GL accounts per division.

resolved_design_count.instructions: How should results be reported with these files?

criteria.two_layers: Separate future-COA design decisions from migration-close decisions: several accounts can be removed from future posting even while legacy balances/references remain provisional.
criteria.all_or_none: No decision is allowed until every missing document arrives.
